name: Montenegro
famous_for: Fjord-like Bay of Kotor, dramatic cliffside Ostrog Monastery, Tara River Canyon (deepest in Europe), and Sveti Stefan island.
tourists: Over 2.6M visitors; highlights include Kotor Old Town, Durmitor National Park alpine lakes, and Budva medieval beaches.
must_know: Montenegro translates literally to 'Black Mountain', named for the dark, dense pine forests covering Mount Lovćen.
fun_fact: The Tara River Canyon plunges up to 1,300 meters (4,265 ft) deep, making it the deepest river canyon in all of Europe.
